videos.headline: Raleek Brown darts in for an early Texas TD
Emmett Mosley V hauls in 43-yard reception for Texas
Cooper Ranvier puts Tennessee on the board with 33-yard field goal
Gianni Spetic makes 22-yard field goal for Texas
Kayin Lee picks off Arch Manning on deep ball
Qua Moss takes punt return 57 yards to the house for Vols
Texas' Colin Simmons penalized for miming urinating on field
Raleek Brown runs for 4-yard TD to extend Texas' lead
